components.name: Triangulation Mark
components.description: Landing hero's signature device: reticle rings, four source nodes, animated sightlines resolving to a signal-orange benchmark point. Landing-exclusive; never duplicated into studio screens.
components.html: <svg viewBox="0 0 400 400" width="200" height="200" class="ds-triangulation"><circle cx="200" cy="200" r="172" stroke="hsl(36 48% 40% / .28)" stroke-dasharray="2 10" fill="none"/><circle cx="200" cy="200" r="122" stroke="hsl(40 16% 82% / .7)" fill="none"/><circle cx="200" cy="200" r="16" fill="hsl(18 82% 46%)" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="200" cy="200" r="6" fill="hsl(18 82% 46%)"/></svg>

narrative.overview: Keystone's landing surface stages a land surveyor's discipline: nothing is asserted until it is triangulated. A reticle sweeps a field of scattered source shapes and lets them resolve into a single cited, confidence-scored point. Deep surveyor's-ink navy grounds the field; brass/bronze carries authority; warm ivory reads as contour paper; signal-orange is spent only where the system is actively certifying something. This is a deliberately Committed palette on the public surface. The four authenticated studios share the exact same token vocabulary but run a Restrained strategy: neutrals plus the one accent, no crosshair sweep, minimal motion. This is a deliberate two-register system, not an inconsistency.
keyCharacteristics: Committed color strategy on landing (one accent, high restraint elsewhere); Restrained variant in the four studios, sharing tokens not intensity.
Reticle/triangulation/contour-line visual grammar, native to the surveying world.
Space Grotesk + IBM Plex Mono as the only two typefaces in the shipped system.
Flat-to-tonal surfaces; the hero's frosted instrument panel is the one deliberate glass moment.
Confidence and status are always color-coded and always visible.

rules.name: The Accent-Means-Something Rule
rules.body: Signal-orange never fills a surface or decorates a passive element. It appears only where the system is asserting confidence or liveness.

rules.name: The Cited Exception Rule
rules.body: --chart-4 is deliberately reused as the semantic success/verified/ready status color across the four studios, in addition to signal-orange. This is the one place the Restrained strategy's single-accent rule is knowingly not followed literally.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Landing runs Committed (full palette expression, hero mechanism, glass panel). The four studios run Restrained (neutrals + signal-orange + the cited chart-4 exception only). Same tokens, different volume, by design.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Only Space Grotesk and IBM Plex Mono ship. Any third typeface is a defect, not an option.

rules.name: The Glass-Is-Scoped Rule
rules.body: Frosted glass exists exactly once — the landing hero's instrument panel. It is not a general card treatment.

dos: Do spend signal-orange only on live/confidence/certifying moments (hero resolution point, confidence readouts, high-confidence tiers, focus/selection) — per the Accent-Means-Something Rule.
Do use --chart-4 for success/verified/ready status across studios, as the one named, cited exception to the single-accent rule — not as license for further raw colors.

Do keep the landing page's Committed intensity (WebGL scene, triangulation animation, glass panel) exclusive to the public marketing surface; keep studios Restrained (tokens shared, theatrics withheld).
Do use the shared Select/Checkbox/Switch/Popover/Tooltip primitives for any new form control; they exist specifically to fix touch-inaccessible native selects and hover-only tooltips.
Do compose new studio screens from CanvasHeader + ContextRibbon + FocusCanvas + Inspector; this is the converged, canonical chrome system.
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above a heading anywhere in the product. This was shipped as a systemic defect and removed outright, including deleting the eyebrow prop from CanvasHeader itself.
Don't introduce a third display typeface. Newsreader was fully removed once weight/style variation within Space Grotesk proved sufficient.
Don't fabricate decorative data visualization. One was shipped in TechnicalProof.tsx, flagged in finish review, and deleted rather than fixed.
Don't use .glass-panel/frosted backdrop-blur as a general card treatment outside the landing hero's instrument panel.

Don't introduce raw Tailwind color utilities (emerald-500, green-500, sky-500, etc.) for status or semantic meaning; route through the existing HSL custom properties even under deadline pressure — this defect class was found and fixed twice before shipping clean.
